# Labels

| Label | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `type:feature`, `type:bug`, `type:chore`, `type:docs`, `type:research` | Kind of work |
| `area:app`, `area:build` | Module or tooling |
| `area:domain`, `area:data`, `area:security` | Topic |
| `priority:high`, `priority:normal`, `priority:low` | Priority |
| `milestone:M0`, `milestone:M1` | Milestone scope |
| `status:blocked` | Waits for another issue |
| `dependencies` | Dependabot updates |
